Veterans Benefits: Mississippi exempts military retired pay from state income tax and does not tax VA disability compensation. Qualifying disabled veterans may also receive additional state and local property-tax benefits.
Description: McHenry is a small unincorporated community in rural Stone County, Mississippi, about 10 miles south of Wiggins and part of the Gulfport-Biloxi metro area. It hosts Adranos' solid rocket motor research, development and production complex on a former General Dynamics site — a Department-of-Defense-compliant munitions facility.
